tools.name: find_insider_trades
tools.description: Insider transactions from SEC Form 4 filings: who (officer, director, 10% owner) bought or sold a company's stock, with transaction code and plain label, shares, price, value, shares owned afterwards, dates and the SEC filing link. Requires at least one of ticker, insider or company. Defaults to ope

tools.name: find_new_business_registrations
tools.description: Newly registered LLCs, corporations and nonprofits from official state open data for NY, CO, CT and OR: name, state, entity type, formation date, status, county, city, ZIP. Use for new-business lead lists. No personal contact data. Max 10 rows per call; window up to 31 days.

tools.name: validate_emails
tools.description: Check email addresses without sending anything: syntax, MX records, disposable domains, role accounts, free providers and likely typos (gmial.com). Returns status valid/risky/invalid, a 0-100 score, reasons and a suggested correction. Up to 25 addresses per call.

tools.name: check_domain_availability
tools.description: Check whether domain names are free or registered using official RDAP. Pass full domains, or brand names plus TLDs. Returns available or registered, registrar, expiry date, age and nameservers. Max 12 domains per call.

tools.name: check_domain_health
tools.description: Audit a domain: DNS records, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), TLS certificate, HTTP behavior and AI/search crawler rules in robots.txt. Returns findings per check. Up to 3 domains per call.

tools.name: extract_pdf_text
tools.description: Download public PDF URLs and return clean text and/or Markdown, page count, metadata and a scanned-PDF flag (image-only PDFs return no text). Up to 2 PDFs per call, up to 50 pages each.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, validate_emails, check_domain_health · Private data: find_funding_leads, find_new_business_registrations, validate_emails, check_domain_health · Public sink: validate_emails, check_domain_health.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, validate_emails, check_domain_health · Private data: find_funding_leads, find_new_business_registrations, validate_emails, check_domain_health · Public sink: validate_emails, check_domain_health

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
